subject: PHY
stem: An ideal 12 V battery is connected across 2 Ω and 4 Ω resistors in series. What current flows through the circuit?
solution: The series resistance is 2 + 4 = 6 Ω. From Ohm's law, I = 12/6 = 2 A.

subject: PHY
stem: A net force accelerates a 2 kg body at 3 m/s². Enter the magnitude of the force in newtons.

subject: PHY
stem: A projectile is launched at 20 m/s at 30° above the horizontal. Take g = 10 m/s². What is its maximum height?
solution: The vertical launch speed is 20 sin 30° = 10 m/s. H = u_y²/(2g) = 100/20 = 5 m.

subject: PHY
stem: Capacitors of 2 μF and 3 μF are connected in parallel. Enter their equivalent capacitance in μF.
solution: Capacitances add in parallel: C = 2 + 3 = 5 μF.

subject: PHY
stem: A 5 Ω resistor carries a steady current of 2 A. What power is dissipated?

subject: PHY
stem: A particle starts with velocity 4 m/s and accelerates uniformly at 2 m/s² for 3 s. Enter its displacement in metres.

subject: CHEM
stem: How many moles are present in 36 g of water? Use a molar mass of 18 g/mol.
solution: Number of moles = mass/molar mass = 36/18 = 2 mol.

subject: CHEM
stem: A neutral atom has atomic number 17. Enter the number of electrons in its outermost shell.
solution: Its configuration is 2, 8, 7, so there are 7 valence electrons.

subject: CHEM
stem: At 25 °C, an aqueous solution has [H⁺] = 10⁻³ mol/L. What is its pH?

subject: CHEM
stem: For 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, excess oxygen reacts with 4 mol of H₂. Enter the moles of H₂O produced.
solution: The mole ratio of H₂ to H₂O is 1:1; 4 mol of hydrogen forms 4 mol of water.

subject: CHEM
stem: Which species has the same number of electrons as neon (atomic number 10)?
solution: Sodium has 11 electrons when neutral; Na⁺ has lost one and therefore has 10.

subject: CHEM
stem: A first-order reaction has a half-life of 10 minutes. What fraction of the reactant remains after 30 minutes?
solution: 30 minutes is three half-lives, so the remaining fraction is (1/2)³ = 1/8.

subject: MATH
stem: For f(x) = x², enter the value of f′(3).

subject: MATH
stem: What is the sum of the roots of x² − 5x + 6 = 0?
solution: For ax² + bx + c, the sum of the roots is −b/a = 5.

subject: MATH
stem: For any real θ, what is sin²θ + cos²θ?
solution: The Pythagorean trigonometric identity gives sin²θ + cos²θ = 1.

subject: MATH
stem: If 2x + 3 = 11, enter the value of x.

subject: MATH
stem: What is the determinant of the matrix [[2, 1], [3, 4]]?

subject: MATH
stem: Enter the value of the definite integral of (2x + 1) from x = 0 to x = 2.
solution: The antiderivative is x² + x. Evaluating at 2 and 0 gives (4 + 2) − 0 = 6.
